study.question: Does the observed advantage of historical-click-stratified action rotation survive removal of every within-stratum action deviation, and does its true-versus-shifted contrast interact with task/shared routing?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: r0043 true-click-stratum rotation gives click AUC0.6658740617022688 (task) and0.66459060357418 (shared), versus shifted-group rotation0.6637280168046223 and0.6618964106291083, respectively. Within each routing, group sizes and theoretical moved-index counts match; executed tensor certificates are absent from the receipts (candidate_diagnostics not_requested), so matching remains provisional. The aligned observed-stop references r0037 are0.6661693800470533 and0.6646058217528154. True-group rotation may protect informative click alignment, but it can also leave within-group action variation partly aligned because of homogeneous or small strata. Centroid projection removes all within-stratum deviations without choosing another permutation. These are single-seed validation observations after adaptive exploration, not significance or mechanism proof. Mechanism hypothesis: much of this path-specific retained value lies in blockwise click-stratum-constant action content, including stratum composition, rather than residual eventwise action matching within a click stratum. Trajectory review: baseline-din0.6555440824200336; unchanged joint g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached0.666753547526167 stays the utility incumbent. All-action zero and context-only replacements g1-r0024-token_zero_task0.6411900073135032 and g1-r0024-token_context_task0.6414296870321845 were unsuccessful as utility replacements, not execution failures. g1-r0025-action_value_task0.6662444304756373 recovered much more than scorer-only actions; splitting pool versus summary actions (g1-r0026-pool_action_task0.6607643852640959 and g1-r0026-summary_action_task0.6599648465675602) was worse than retaining both. Capacity-preserving item-summary replacement g1-r0034-match_itemdup_task0.6637250089493206 also failed to recover aligned observed utility. Stopped observed r0037 versus unrestricted rotation g1-r0038-match_rotate_stop_task0.663743611195438 motivated the partition controls. Basis changes were optimization-sensitive: g1-r0042-match_hadamard_transport_task0.6662306256117998 did not establish a better mechanism. No runtime execution error is pending; negative scientific trajectories are retained as counterevidence. These sources do not establish that all joint-vs-DIN gain is causally due to actions or that this new diagnostic improves utility.

study.proposed_difference: Conditional projection: within each original10-position block and each of the two click/nonclick strata, replace an action embedding by the average of observed valid action embeddings in that stratum. The shifted control rotates only the binary membership by half the valid count within the same block, preserving the two group sizes; it does not move original items, actions or task masks. Compute group means and backprojection by two FP32 batched products with autocast disabled, cast to inherited dtype, then execute the unchanged summaries. The existing selector consumes projected action coordinates only in rows0/4, with their inherited local action-input gradients stopped; observed direct pools and ordinal action channels remain live. Group sums/block totals are preserved in exact arithmetic, within-group residuals vanish and norms contract. This retains each block/stratum auxiliary-action composition and all other observed action paths; it cannot identify click-bit-only sufficiency or total historical-action value. Four standalone modules cross true/shifted groups with task/shared residual routing. No learned state, width, RNG, training-loss or frozen-contract change. Rotate mode retains an exact-code bridge to each materialized r0043 source. No architecture originality claim is made. Then check mean cells for finite four-task forward/backward, equal initial state/parameter counts, unchanged branch values/gradients and ownership. Zero final residual layers make initial prediction agreement alone insufficient. Alter invalid history IDs/actions and target action at fixed legal masks: predictions must be invariant for empty,singleton,partial,noncontiguous,full histories; malformed/absent task masks must fail. No valid contributor may come from another stratum/block/sample or an invalid position. True-minus-shifted centroid AUC>=0.001 for each routing; all four tasks and costs still reported even if auxiliary outcomes worsen.
Group and whole-block action sums remain equal within declared tolerance; within-group residual variation disappears; item/ordinal/pool paths stay identical at common state.
No directional interaction prediction is justified by existing evidence; any interaction requires repeats before mechanistic support.
falsifiers: True centroid loses more than0.0005 versus true rotation in a matched routing: reject the practical retained-utility prediction for that routing; it does not refute all action utility.
True-minus-shifted centroid is null/reversed, or removed variation is negligible: proposed group-alignment interpretation is weakened or non-identifiable.
Effects fail to repeat, or disappear with appropriate energy/optimization controls: do not claim a mechanism.
